metadata.question: Does Houston show higher nighttime light intensity in December 2012 and 2013 compared to the average light output during other months from 2012 to 2014?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does Houston show higher nighttime light intensity in December 2012 and 2013 compared to the average light output during other months from 2012 to 2014?" We need to: 1. Search strategy: Use nighttime light data (DMSP-OLS or VIIRS). Since it's 2012-2014, we can use VIIRS monthly composites (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) which starts from 2012. Band: 'avg_rad'. 2. Location: Houston, Texas. Define a point or polygon around Houston metro area. 3. Time periods: - December 2012 and December 2013: get these two months' images and average their radiance. - Other months (Jan-Nov 2012, Jan-Nov 2013, Jan-Dec 2014 but exclude Dec 2012 and Dec 2013): average across all these months. - Compare: Is (Dec2012 + Dec2013)/2 > average of other months? 4. Masking: Nighttime light data doesn't require cloud masking, but we need to handle missing data (pixels with no data/negative values). We'll check valid pixel counts. 5. Logic: - Check if collections for each period have images. - Compute mean radiance for each period over the Houston region. - Validate results: radiance should be non-negative. If any result is NaN or None, output C3. - If the December average > other months average → A (Yes), else B (No). Potential issues: - VIIRS monthly data might have gaps. Check collection size. - Use scale=1000 for reduceRegion to avoid timeout. Steps: 1. Define Houston geometry (point with buffer or polygon). 2. Get December 2012 and December 2013 images. 3. Get other months (2012-2014 excluding Dec 2012 and Dec 2013). 4. For each set, compute mean radiance over the region. 5. Compare and output answer. We must output concise evidence (max 20 lines) and final tag. Let's structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var houston = ee.Geometry.Point(-95.3698, 29.7604).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Houston center // Define time ranges var dec2012_start = '2012-12-01'; var dec2012_end = '2012-12-31'; var dec2013_start = '2013-12-01'; var dec2013_end = '2013-12-31'; var other_start = '2012-01-01'; var other_end = '2014-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - VIIRS Monthly Nighttime Lights var viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .select('avg_rad'); // Get December 2012 and 2013 images var dec2012 = viirs.filterDate(dec2012_start, dec2012_end); var dec2013 = viirs.filterDate(dec2013_start, dec2013_end); var decembers = dec2012.merge(dec2013); // Get other months (2012-2014, exclude Dec 2012 and Dec 2013) var otherMonths = viirs.filterDate(other_start, other_end) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 11, 'month')) // Exclude December (month=12) .merge(viirs.filterDate('2014-12-01', '2014-12-31')); // Include Dec 2014 // 3. Check collection sizes var decSize = decembers.size().getInfo(); var otherSize = otherMonths.size().getInfo(); console.log('December 2012/2013 images:', decSize); console.log('Other months images:', otherSize); if (decSize === 0 || otherSize === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Compute mean radiance for each set // For Decembers: average of the two months var decMeanImg = decembers.mean(); // For other months: average across all images var otherMeanImg = otherMonths.mean(); // Reduce regions var decStats = decMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var otherStats = otherMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var decRad = decStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var otherRad = otherStats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); // Also get pixel counts to check for valid data var decCount = decMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); var otherCount = otherMeanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: houston, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log('December avg radiance:', decRad, 'Valid pixels:', decCount); console.log('Other months avg radiance:', otherRad, 'Valid pixels:', otherCount); // 5. Validation if (decCount === 0 || otherCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (decRad === null || otherRad === null || isNaN(decRad) || isNaN(otherRad) || decRad < 0 || otherRad < 0) { // Radiance should be non-negative console.log('C3'); return; } // 6. Comparison and final answer var isHigher = decRad > otherRad; console.log('December > Other months?', isHigher); if (isHigher) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
